description: MUST-FAIL: the JSON input contains two members whose decoded Unicode names are both 'a'. RFC 8785 requires I-JSON input, so a conforming implementation rejects the duplicate rather than retaining either value before canonicalization.
spec_ref: draft-mih-sokolov-scitt-payload-binding-03, Algorithm jcs; RFC 8785 Section 3.1; RFC 7493 Section 2.3
